name: Tiltcasting
summary: A smartphone tilted in the air controls a virtual plane that slices through a 3D scene on a large display; targets are touched on the phone.
howItWorks: The orientation of the phone positions a selection plane in the scene. Objects intersected by the plane appear on the phone's screen, where the user taps the intended one, so occluded objects become reachable.
